serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Acumen’s SkyShaper Technologies (SST) provides government agency clients with Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) offerings with the ability to utilize data management and visualization, statistical analysis, and project management applications in one secure environment. Through SST's offerings, users can perform wide array of functions including on-demand computation of complex data models, high speed file transfers, and large data storage in various supported formats and structures.
